summary_1line: Bhishma explains elemental properties, mind and intellect traits, and creation’s entities; Yudhishthira questions death after seeing fallen kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows teaching Yudhishthira as the battlefield of fallen kings stretches behind them.
A symbolic tableau of the five elements—earth, water, fire, wind, and space—radiating their qualities around a meditating sage.
Yudhishthira gazes over the field where mighty kings lie lifeless on the bare ground after battle.
